text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, so frustrating...! This is so 
frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And after I swore I wouldn't lose again, 
of all things!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And yet... Why did I end up losing...!?
choice_data_list: We can definitely win next time, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I don't need any empty comfort!!
choice_data_list: 今度は必ず勝てるよ、ウインディ！
choice_data_list_en: We'll definitely win this time, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy doesn't get it at all-noda!! 
Windy-chan doesn't ever wanna go through 
this again-noda!
choice_data_list: 悔しいなら大丈夫だよ！
choice_data_list_en: If you're feeling frustrated, then you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A weapon...? Can feelings of frustration 
really become a weapon...?
choice_data_list: その闘争心は最高の武器だから！
choice_data_list_en: Because that fighting spirit is your greatest weapon!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then that means you've gotten stronger...! 
After all, you felt more frustrated than 
anyone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I shall win!! I'll win, and 
laugh triumphantly!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Still... Windy-chan tried so hard, too...
choice_data_list:
Villains never give up until the very end, 
right?

Villains never give up until the very end, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right...! Evil never gives 
up...!
choice_data_list: 悪は最後まで諦めないものだろ？
悪は最後まで諦めないものでしょ？
choice_data_list_en: Villains never give up until the very end, right?
Villains never give up until the very end, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep fighting... No matter how strong 
my opponent is...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"That's evil!! And that's who Windy-chan 
is!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll repay this debt with victory! Just 
you wait—next time, I shall surely win!!
